item.title: WRE News: As Florida’s Population Boom Cools, Miami Draws Six-Figure Earners
item.description: Miami, FL - February 18, 2026 - Florida’s pandemic population boom may be over—but Miami is still cashing in on six-figure newcomers. Net migration to Florida has plunged 93% from its 2022 peak, falling from more than 310,000 new residents during the height of the pandemic surge to just 22,517 last year, according to U.S. Census data.
